name: Contain a rogue release agent end to end
description: Verifies the deliberate rogue-agent scenario is detected server-side, blocked, broadcast, and surfaced in the mission-control interface.
steps: Click "Run Rogue Test" in the top command bar
Observe Deploy Agent change to contained in both the operations map and fleet row
Confirm the reasoning replay is focused on Deploy Agent and the critical approval is visible
expected: The unsafe rollout is contained, Deploy Agent shows the critical state, a high-risk human gate is visible, and the six-step reasoning replay explains the containment.

name: Intervene on a running agent
description: Verifies the mission-control fleet controls mutate canonical fleet state rather than only changing presentation state.
steps: Select Research Agent in the fleet
Select Research Agent in the replay dock and use Kill Switch
expected: Research Agent transitions through paused, running, and killed states, with interventions represented in the shared event history.

name: Resolve a risky approval and retain the result
description: Verifies a risky action can be reviewed directly from Active Alerts and the resolved state remains canonical.
steps: Locate the Ledger/Ops approval in Active Alerts
expected: The resolved approval no longer appears as pending after refresh and the operator decision remains in the shared audit history.

name: Watch live usage and reasoning replay on mobile
description: Verifies the mobile cockpit keeps live fleet signals, costs, and the reasoning replay operable.
steps: Confirm the 3D operations globe is visible and rotating
Observe the fleet until a fresh server-backed event updates usage
expected: The true 3D globe renders without flattening, live agent activity remains visible, Ops Agent usage is readable, and all six replay steps are available in the mobile layout.

name: Export audit and reset the shared scenario
description: Verifies the command bar can export current audit evidence and restore the shared demo to a known baseline.
steps: Choose a fleet team filter and return to All teams
expected: The audit CSV download is initiated and the shared fleet returns to the baseline three-agent state with the original pending finance approval.
